newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-TURKEY AND FINLAND REACH UNINSPIRING DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TURKEY AND FINLAND REACH UNINSPIRING DRAW.

text.p: Turkey and Finland, each struggling in their World Cup qualifying groups, drew 1-1 in an uninspired friendly in the Turkish town of Denizli on Wednesday.
Finland took the lead in the 18th minute with a 20-metre shot from Jari Litmanen which bounced awkwardly to beat diving Turkish goalkeeper Engin Ipekoglu.

The Turks responded 10 minutes later with a goal from Tolunay Kafkas from a chip which flatfooted defenders and goalkeeper alike, leaving them appealing for off-side while Kafkas tapped the ball into the net.
Turkey controlled most of the game in the second half but were unable to convert their dominance into goals against a tight Finnish defence.
